g.text: Origin panels retain every saved value within r <= 0.45 rs; no vertical clipping. Signed error and norms retain the whole domain, including the origin and shock.

g.text: Relative norms use matching exact-density norms. Volume measures: planar dr; cylindrical r dr; spherical r^2 dr. No center/shock exclusion.

g.text: A shock/center layer can keep Linf large while integrated errors decrease; no universal convergence order is inferred.
